summary: This patch extracts a new reusable skill for frozen meal/inventory recovery tracking from a successful task run. The trace demonstrates a pattern of reading multiple related Excel workbooks (Template, Stock, Recovery Log), handling revision-based deduplication (keep highest revision per Load ID), filtering by status (Booked/Loaded vs Tentative/Cancelled), calculating coverage metrics with Days On Hand and out-of-stock projections, and writing to specific output sheets. This is distinct from the existing supply-chain-coverage-analysis skill which focuses on rack/lane/branch variants with different data structures. The new skill captures the template-based workbook refresh pattern with Coverage_Detail and Recovery_Loads output sheets.
